name: DeepSeek Harness
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null || nvm install 22; export CI=true; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build
start: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null; export CI=true; pnpm dsh web --no-open --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3080
